jq.name: the page's three read tools and the agent's two record tools are exactly the surface
the surface's create tools fill nothing at runtime, so the page could call them (it does not)
the plugin binds only the patches folder, writable only for remove_patch, and may only insert PrExplorerDiff
bash runs only the listed programs, token for token: no shell strings, no git -C, no push/checkout/config
jq.expr: [.config.tools[] | select(.tools_id == "pr-explorer-tools")][0].host.bash | .network_mode == "enabled" and .allowed_argv_prefixes == [["git",  "rev-parse"],  ["git",  "merge-base"],  ["git",  "diff"],  ["git",  "log"],  ["git",  "show"],  ["git",  "ls-files"],  ["git",  "remote",  "get-url"],  ["git",  "worktree",  "list"],  ["git",  "fetch",  "--no-tags",  "origin"],  ["gh",  "pr",  "view"],  ["date",  "-u"],  ["mkdir",  "-p"]] and ([.allowed_argv_prefixes[] | select(.[0] == "/bin/sh" or .[0] == "sh" or (.[0] == "git" and (.[1] == "-C" or .[1] == "-c" or .[1] == "push" or .[1] == "checkout" or .[1] == "config" or .[1] == "update-ref")))] | length == 0)

jq.name: units carry files as a JSON string, never a list field
PrExplorerDiff has exactly one unique key (file_key), which the plugin's on_conflict writes need
jq.expr: .assets["schemas/pr_explorer_diff.graphql"] | ([scan("@index\\(unique: true\\)")] | length == 1) and test("file_key: String @index\\(unique: true\\)")

jq.name: the prompt stops before recording an analysis whose files were not written
the prompt writes patches outside every repository and always cleans up
the prompt forbids ref changes, fetches by commit id only, and ends on the page directive
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/pr_explorer/system_prompt.md"] | contains("never check out") and contains("git fetch --no-tags origin <baseRefOid> <headRefOid>") and contains("never a branch, a `:` or `+`") and contains("::pr-explorer{analysis=\"<analysis_id>\"}")

jq.name: the prompt asks which clone when several match, and handles github.com only
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/pr_explorer/system_prompt.md"] | contains("More than one: ask the user and wait for the reply") and contains("Only github.com for now") and contains("--git-common-dir")

jq.name: the prompt runs commands as argv with cwd, never shell strings or -C
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/pr_explorer/system_prompt.md"] | contains("Never pass a shell") and (test("`git -C ") | not)
